R7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
sci-Plex profiled at 24 hours; our plateau is 7 to 12 hours. And the harmonised dose
scale does not map cleanly onto the ENCODE series' 100 nM. A weak R2 is as
consistent with those mismatches as with a real absence.
sci-Plex uses nuclear hashing and combinatorial indexing, so counts per cell are low
-- a few thousand UMIs. Single-cell estimates are therefore noisier than droplet
Perturb-seq and R4's floor is biased upward relative to a 10x experiment.
A drug response and a genetic knockdown are different interventions. R5 compares
them as PREDICTORS of one target, which is fair, but says nothing about which is the
better instrument in general -- and the K562 arm is 200 columns against this one.
